source: 610 “New Life”
target: 610 “Nova Vita”

source: In the face of the infant’s cries, which gradually weakened him, Lumian teleported immediately to Father Montserrat’s side, launching a powerful attack to disrupt the impending impact.
target: In facie infantilis gemitus, qui eum paulatim debilitabat, Lumian statim ad latus Patris Montserrat se translocavit, impetum validum iniiciens ut imminentem ictum perturbaret.

source: Yet, in that very moment, he observed the Pride Armor freezing in place upon hearing the infant’s cry.
target: Sed in eo ipso momento animadvertit Armaturam Superbiam in loco immobilitasse, audito infantis gemitu.

source: Suddenly, it crouched down and plunged the Sword of Dawn into the ground covered in dark weeds.
target: Subito, ea se incurvavit et Gladium Aurorae in terram, herbis obscurissimis opertam, infigit.

source: Dammit! Directly employing Hurricane of Light?
target: Per deos! Num directe "Turbo Lucis" adhibetur?

source: Lumian’s scalp tingled.
target: Vertex Lumiani formicationem sensit.

source: Without bothering to confirm, he shifted the teleportation destination, vanishing into the darkness of the illusory oak tree, and reappeared on the ship’s deck.
target: Ne confirmans solertia, metam translocationis mutavit, evanescens in obscuritate quercus illusoriae, et in tabulato navis reapparuit.

source: He had long recognized that Father Montserrat’s weed wilderness was inferior to the Madames’ Paramita.
target: Diu intellexerat solitudinem herbarum Patris Montserrat inferior esse quam Paramita Madamarum.

source: It failed to sever the deep connection between the inside and outside, nor could it prevent teleportation.
target: Illud non potuit disiungere nexum profundum inter intus et foris, nec translationem prohibere.

source: Its sole capability was restraining various sounds and the aftermath of battle, akin to the Bottle of Fiction, if not less.
target: Unica eius facultas erat varias sonos atque eventus belli cohibere, instar Lagenae Fictae, si non minus.

source: Nonetheless, this wilderness had unique abilities.
target: Attamen, haec solitudo facultates singulares habebat.

source: As Lumian’s figure faded into the dark wilderness, the Sword of Dawn embedded in the ground by the Pride Armor shattered, transforming into countless light fragments, creating a formidable storm that engulfed the area.
target: Dum figura Lumiani in solitudinem obscuram evanuit, Gladius Aurorae, a Armatura Superbiam in terram infigta, fractus est et in innumeros fragmenta lucis conversus, tempestatem formidabilem creans quae locum totum comprehendit.

source: The plump wheat-filled weeds were sliced into pieces, leaving the ground barren.
target: Herbae pingues, triticeo repletes, in frusta secatae sunt, terram inanitam relinquentes.

source: Father Montserrat, perched on the oak branch, couldn’t dodge in time.
target: Pater Montserrat, super ramum quercus insidens, tempore vitare non potuit.

source: He only managed to manifest his body into something resembling wood before being consumed by the Hurricane of Light.
target: Tantum potuit corpus suum in formam ligni transformare, antequam a Turbo Lucis devoraretur.

source: The illusory, hollow cry of a baby abruptly ceased.
target: Clamor infantis, illusorius et cavus, repente cessavit.

source: When the Hurricane of Light subsided, Father Montserrat stood frozen in place.
target: Cum Turbo Lucis quietus factus est, Pater Montserrat in loco congelatus stetit.

source: In the next moment, his wood-like body, covered in brown bark, split open, revealing deep crevices.
target: In momento sequenti, corpus eius, quasi ligni, cortice fusco opertum, scissum est, revelans profundas fissuras.

source: Pa, pa, pa. Father Montserrat’s body fell to the bottom of the oak tree, piece by piece.
target: Pa, pa, pa. Corpus Patris Montserrat singulis partibus in imum quercus cecidit.

source: The incisions were smooth, and blood seeped out.
target: Incisiones lenes erant, et sanguis effluere coepit.

source: Flesh and blood were instantly absorbed by the illusory oak tree’s roots, leaving nothing behind.
target: Caro et sanguis statim radicibus quercus illusoriae absorpti sunt, nihil relinquentes.

source: In the middle section of the oak tree, the bark split open.
target: In media parte quercus, cortex scissum est.

source: Squirming, moist flesh grew out, expanding into a hole.
target: Caro umida, se contorquens, exorta est, in cavum expandens.

source: A human head appeared, squeezed and ejected.
target: Caput humanum apparuit, compressum et eiectum.

source: In the blink of an eye, the naked human was “born” by the illusory oak tree. It was Father Montserrat.
target: In momento oculi, nudus homo a quercu illusorio "natus" est. Erat Pater Montserrat.

source: He retained his adult form, his body wet and partially covered in a dirty, translucent white membrane.
target: Adultam formam retinuit; corpus eius madidum erat et partim membrana alba, sordida et translucida, opertum habebat.

source: New life!
target: Nova vita!

source: With the aid of the weed-covered darkness, the illusionary oak tree, and the invisible baby, Father Montserrat found a new lease of life!
target: Auxilio obscuritatis herbis opertae, quercus illusoriae, et infantuli invisibilis, Pater Montserrat novam vitam invenit!

source: His brow smoothed, and his eyes regained a youthful gleam.
target: Frontales rugis levatae sunt, et oculi eius nitorem iuvenilem recuperaverunt.

source: Enormous bat-like wings, shrouded in dark skin, erupted from his back, propelling him from the heart of the colossal oak to his silver-white full-body armor.
target: Alae ingentes, similes vespertilionum, tegmine cute obscura circumdactae, ex dorso eius eruperunt, impellentes eum ab corde quercus ingentis ad loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam.

source: The Pride Armor rose, summoning light into its hand, forging a sharp spear.
target: Armatura Superbia surrexit, lucem in manum evocans, hastam acutam fingens.

source: Launching the elongated lance with relentless force, it sliced through the air, embedding into Father Montserrat’s chest.
target: Lancea elongata cum vi inexori proiecta, per aerem secunda, in pectore Patris Montserrat infigitur.

source: Father Montserrat’s bat-like wings enveloped him, and his form shattered into palm-sized black bats.
target: Alae Patris Montserrat, similes vespertilionum, eum complectebant, et forma eius in vespertiliones nigros, manudoris magnitudinis, scissa est.

source: In a mesmerizing dance, the bats circled behind the Pride Armor, reforming into Father Montserrat, adorned with a grimy membrane.
target: In choro incantatore, vespertiliones post Armaturam Superbiam circumvolitabant, se iterum in Patrem Montserrat reformantes, membrana sordida ornati.

source: Father Montserrat’s body expanded, morphing into a colossal bear.
target: Corpus Patris Montserrat ampliatum est, in ursam colossalem mutatum.

source: From his palms sprouted sharp claws etched with enigmatic patterns.
target: Ex palmis eius ungues acuti, figuris arcani inscripti, exortae sunt.

source: With a forceful swipe, he etched five deep gouges onto the Pride Armor’s back, unveiling its hollow interior.
target: Vi ictu impetuoso, quinque fossas profundas in dorso Armaturae Superbiae incisit, interiora eius cava revelans.

source: The Pride Armor froze, and the air itself seemed to still.
target: Armatura Superbia congelata est, et aer ipse immobilis videbatur.

source: Before Father Montserrat could launch another assault, he noticed the silver-white full-body armor pivoting without warning.
target: Antequam Pater Montserrat aliam impetum iniicere posset, animadvertit loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam sine praemonitione verti.

source: Condensing hammers, axes, and flails made of light, it slashed at Father Montserrat frenziedly.
target: Malleos, securis, et verbera ex luce facta condensans, furiose in Patrem Montserrat percussit.

source: Father Montserrat lowered himself, shrinking to the cleared ground, inching towards the illusionary oak tree.
target: Pater Montserrat se deiecit, in terram expurgatam minuens, ad quercum illusoriam paulatim accedens.

source: The ground beneath him caved, forming a rift.
target: Terra sub eo conflavit, fissuram formans.

source: In that moment, Lumian, sensing the end of the Hurricane of Light, teleported back into the darkness.
target: In eo momento, Lumian, finem Turbo Lucis sentiens, se in tenebras revera translocavit.

source: To his surprise, Father Montserrat stood unscathed, devoid of the brown priest’s attire.
target: Ad mirationem eius, Pater Montserrat integerrimus stetit, vestimenta sacerdotalia fusca abest.

source: Undeterred, Lumian retrieved the Symphony of Hatred bone flute from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Intrepidus, Lumian symphoniam odii tibiae ossium ex sacculo viatoris recepit.

source: Seizing the moment while the Pride Armor entangled Father Montserrat, preventing the transmission of sound to the outside world, Lumian aimed to play a melody learned from Port Santa’s various celebrations—composed by a Church of Earth Mother Saint for a bountiful harvest.
target: Carpendo momentum dum Armatura Superbia Patrem Montserrat implicabat, impediens sonum transmitti ad mundum externum, Lumian intenderat melodiam canere, quam ex variis celebrationibus Portus Santae didicerat—compositam ab Ecclesia Sanctae Matris Terrae pro copia messis.

source: Typically, Lumian would don the Flog boxing gloves, “teleport” closer, stimulate some desire or emotion in Father Montserrat through a punch, and then play the Symphony of Hatred to trigger Flog’s aftereffects.
target: Typice, Lumian braccas pugilatas Flog indueret, propius se translocans, aliquod desiderium aut affectum in Patre Montserrat per ictum excitans, atque deinde Symphoniam Odii canebat ad effectus posteros Flog excitandos.

source: However, Lumian abandoned this well-practiced routine.
target: Tamen, Lumian hanc praeclaram consuetudinem deseruit.

source: The peculiar illusionary oak tree on the battlefield gave him pause.
target: Quercus illusoria peculiaris in campo proelii eum detinuit.

source: Father Montserrat had carried an invisible baby, possibly a Child of God.
target: Pater Montserrat infans invisibilis portaverat, fortasse puer Dei.

source: Wearing the Flog boxing gloves could attract attention and danger.
target: Indutio braccarum pugilatarum Flog attentionem et periculum allicere poterat.

source: If the Great Mother perceived it and allowed the Child of God to breach the illusory-reality barrier to confront him, the consequences would be dire!
target: Si Magna Mater id percepisset et Puer Dei sinisset fines inter illusam et veram realitatem transgredi ut eum oppugnarent, consequentiae terribiles futuros essent!

source: Moreover, Lumian suspected that heretics like Montserrat harbored evident psychological issues, making their mental states unpredictable.
target: Praeterea, Lumian suspicabatur haereticos similes Montserrat claras quaestiones psychologicas gerere, quae statum eorum mentis incertum facerent.

source: Playing the Symphony of Hatred directly could exploit this vulnerability, much like how he and Mr. K detested hearing others play the Symphony of Hatred.
target: Symphoniam Odii directe canere hanc infirmitatem expropriare poterat, sicut quomodo ipse et Dominus K alios canentes Symphoniam Odii undique fastidiebant.

source: Uncertain about which weakness might be triggered or the ensuing changes, Lumian planned to roll with the uncertainties.
target: Nescientes quam debilitas excitanda esset aut quae mutationes subsequentes fieri, Lumian consilium cepit incertitudinibus adsequi.

source: Just as Lumian raised the Symphony of Hatred to his lips, an eerie chill crawled down his spine.
target: Iam ut Lumian Symphoniam Odii ad labia levavit, frigoris insoliti formido per spinam eius serpens descendit.

source: “Waaa!”
target: “Waaa!”

source: The spectral baby’s cries reverberated, mere inches from him.
target: Clamores infantis phantasmatici resonaverunt, non multos pollices a eo distantibus.

source: “Hehe, hehe.”
target: “Hehe, hehe.”

source: The baby’s cries morphed into laughter, as if engaged in an intriguing game with Lumian.
target: Clamores infantis in risum mutati sunt, quasi cum Lumiano in ludo intriganti versarentur.

source: An inexplicable stiffness gripped Lumian, freezing him momentarily.
target: Rigiditas inexplicabilis Lumiani complevit, eum paulisper congelans.

source: A cold aura infiltrated his body, spreading gradually to his abdomen.
target: Aura frigida in corpus eius penetravit, paulatim ad abdominis regionem diffundens.

source: As his life began to ebb away, merging with the cold aura, the baby in his ear oscillated between mournful wails and gleeful laughter.
target: Dum vita eius defluere inchoabat, cum aura frigida coniungebatur, infans in aurā eius inter lugubria lamenta et hilarum risum oscillabat.

source: Without hesitation, Lumian plunged his consciousness into his right hand, activating Blood Emperor Alista Tudor’s residual brand.
target: Sine mora, Lumian conscientiam suam in dextram manum immergit, residuum sigillum Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor excitans.

source: A violent and frenzied aura erupted from Lumian, enlarging him without relying on his Compression strength.
target: Aura violenta et furibunda a Lumiano erupit, eum amplificans sine spe virtutis compressionis.

source: Tangible bloodlust filled the air.
target: Tangibilis cupiditas sanguinis aerem replevit.

source: The invisible baby’s cries and laughter abruptly ceased, and the coldness invading Lumian’s body dissipated under the searing sensation.
target: Clamores et risus infantis invisibilis repente cessaverunt, et frigora, quae corpus Lumiani invaserant, sub sensu ardenti evanuerunt.

source: The dark wilderness swayed, casting a faint glow.
target: Solitudo obscura oscillabat, tenui luce fulgens.

source: Lumian, in control, terminated the activation and blew into the black bone flute with blood-colored holes.
target: Lumian, moderans, activationem finivit et in tibiam ossis nigram cum foraminibus sanguine coloratis sufflavit.

source: A noticeably jubilant melody echoed, stunning Father Montserrat locked in battle with the Pride Armor.
target: Melodia evidenter laeta resonavit, stupefacens Patrem Montserrat in proelio cum Armatura Superbiam constringentem.

source: His face twisted in indescribable agony.
target: Vultus eius in dolore ineffabili contorti est.

source: Witnessing the silver armor wielding a staff of condensed light, Father Montserrat instinctively reached out, pointing at the adversary’s feet.
target: Videns loricam argenteam baculo lucis condensatae ferre, Pater Montserrat instinctive manum extendit, ad pedes adversarii intendens.

source: Countless vines, weeds, and tree branches sprouted rapidly, entwining the Pride Armor and impeding its movements.
target: Innumerabiles vinae, herbae, et rami arborum celeriter exortae sunt, Armaturam Superbiam implicantes et motus eius impeditantes.

source: Amidst the cacophony of crashing branches and tearing vines, the Pride Armor advanced laboriously, slowed by the entanglement.
target: Inter strepitum rami confractarii et ramorum laniantium, Armatura Superbia labore prosequebatur, intricamento retardata.

source: Father Montserrat locked eyes with Lumian and, in a pained plea, shouted,
target: Pater Montserrat oculos cum Lumiano coniunxit et, suppliciter doleo, exclamavit,

source: “Run!
target: “Fuge!

source: “The Child of God can’t be killed!”
target: “Puer Dei interficiri non potest!”

source: Run? Wh… Lumian realized Father Montserrat seemed more grounded than before. The warmth in his gaze, the familiarity of home, replaced by agony and conflict.
target: Fuge? Quid... Lumian animadvertit Patrem Montserrat magis terrenis quam antea esse. Calor in aspectu eius, familiaritas domus, dolore et conflictu substituta erant.

source: “Run!
target: “Fuge!

source: “Repent to Mother Earth on my behalf!”
target: “Poenitentiam age pro me ad Matrem Terram!”

source: Father Montserrat screamed in hysteria.
target: Pater Montserrat in hysteria clamavit.

source: His naked form underwent an abnormal transformation.
target: Eius forma nuda transformationem inusitatam passa est.

source: Organs, symbolic of creation and incubation, sprouted under the translucent, filthy white membrane, intertwining in a horrific display.
target: Organa, creationis et incubationis symbola, sub membrana alba, translucida et immunda, exortae sunt, inter se implicantes in spectaculo horribili.

source: Repent to Mother Earth? Lumian vaguely understood Father Montserrat’s current state.
target: “Poenitentiam age ad Matrem Terram?” Lumian vage intellexit statum praesentem Patris Montserrat.

source: His corruption appeared incomplete, retaining a side that clung to faith in Earth Mother, resulting in a split personality.
target: Corruptio eius imperfecta apparuit, retinens partem quae ad fidem in Matrem Terram haerebat, quae personalitatem dividendam effecit.

source: Typically, the normal persona remained suppressed by the corrupted one.
target: Typice, persona normalis ab illa corrupta comprimebatur.

source: Is this the problem that the Symphony of Hatred triggered, allowing Father Montserrat’s normal personality to temporarily gain an advantage and regain control of his body?
target: Num hic est quaestio quam Symphonia Odii excitavit, sinens normalem personalitatem Patris Montserrat ad tempus praevacare atque iterum corporis sui imperium recuperare?

source: Lumian sighed, but this didn’t prevent him from condensing crimson fireballs that were nearly white, launching them towards the mutated Father Montserrat.
target: Lumian suspiravit, sed hoc eum non impedivit globulos ignis rubri paene albi condensare, eosque in Patrem Montserrat mutatum proicere.

source: Montserrat’s countenance shifted between frigidity and anguish.
target: Vultus Montserrat inter frigoris et angoris motus mutatus est.

source: His body alternated between evasion and restraint.
target: Corpus eius inter effugiendos et coercitionem alternabat.

source: With all his might, he exclaimed, “The Child of God cannot be killed, only banished!”
target: Omnibus viribus, exclamavit: “Puer Dei interficiri non potest, sed solum in exilium mittendus est!”

source: As Father Montserrat spoke, the crimson fireballs, nearly white, exploded upon him.
target: Dum Pater Montserrat loquebatur, globuli ignis rubri paene albi super eum explosi sunt.

source: The silver-white Pride Armor breached the obstruction of vines and branches, charging forward with a light-conjured staff.
target: Armatura Superbia argenteo-alba obstructionem vinearum et ramorum perrupit, et baculo lucis evocato impetu incedens progressa est.

source: Rumble!
target: Roncitus!

source: Upon the fireball’s detonation, the fallen Father Montserrat wrested control of his body, attempting to retreat underground.
target: Globuli ignis detonatione, Pater Montserrat lapsus imperium corporis sui recuperavit, conans se subter recedere.

source: In that instant, Lumian materialized behind him, brandishing the black bone flute.
target: In illo instante, Lumian post eum apparuit, tibiam ossium nigram extollens.

source: Lumian teleported into the explosion’s epicenter, unconcerned about the potentially severe injuries from the formidable shockwave!
target: Lumian se in centrum explosionis translocavit, nec curans de vulneribus gravibus, quae ex impetu terribili oriri potuerunt!

source: The fireball was a decoy. The true lethal strike he primed was the Symphony of Hatred!
target: Globulus ignis lusus erat. Vera ictus letalis, quem paravit, erat Symphonia Odii!

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: Lumian thrust the black bone flute with blood-colored holes into Father Montserrat’s diminishing neck.
target: Lumian tibiam ossium nigram cum foraminibus sanguine coloratis in collum minuendum Patris Montserrat impulit.

source: Rumble!
target: Roncitus!

source: The expanding flames engulfed them both.
target: Flammae expansivae eos ambo voraverunt.
